scope: Independent adversarial data audit (DA10) of three current-holding dossiers not previously checked by this auditor: CAH, COR, VEEV. 21 load-bearing facts checked (7/7/7 by ticker), selected for the claims most likely to break a thesis or a kill criterion if wrong: headline quarterly/annual figures, guidance track records, leverage and debt, opioid/litigation accruals and status, goodwill impairments, deal/settlement terms, and balance-sheet items. Special attention paid to consolidated vs segment vs subsidiary figures, non-calendar fiscal years (CAH FYE Jun-30, COR FYE Sep-30, VEEV FYE Jan-31), and GAAP vs adjusted/non-GAAP figures. Method: primary sources only -- SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex-99.1 earnings-release exhibits, 10-Q/10-K text, notes and R-file XBRL viewer exhibits, and data.sec.gov XBRL companyconcept pulls -- fetched directly from www.sec.gov and data.sec.gov and cited by accession/URL below. Each dossier was read to its end (no appended Correction sections were found on any of the three). Each ticker's one-line thesis and first kill criterion were checked for consistency with the underlying filings; results noted in the summary (see da10_factcheck.md section 4).

facts.claim: FY2026 guidance track record: adjusted diluted EPS raised/held at every checkpoint (initial $17.45-$17.75 -> Q1 reaffirmed unchanged -> Q2 raised to $17.65-$17.90 -> Q3 raised to $17.75-$17.95); total-company revenue growth guidance held at 7%-9% at the initial (Q4/FY25) release and at Q1 FY26 (reaffirmed, unchanged), before being cut to 4%-6% at Q3 FY26
facts.source: COR Q4/FY2025, Q1/Q2/Q3 FY2026 8-K Ex-99.1 earnings releases, "Fiscal Year 2026 Expectations" guidance tables
facts.source_value: Q4/FY2025 release (initial FY26 guide) table: "Revenue: 5% to 7% growth" (not 7-9%); Adjusted diluted EPS "$17.45 to $17.75". Q1 FY26 release table: "Revenue: 7% to 9% growth" (i.e., raised from the initial 5-7%, not reaffirmed); Adjusted diluted EPS "Reaffirmed at $17.45 to $17.75". Q2 FY26: EPS "raised from the previous range of $17.45 to $17.75 to a range of $17.65 to $17.90"; revenue not re-quoted at the same breakout. Q3 FY26: EPS "raised...to a range of $17.75 to $17.95"; revenue "4% to 6% growth"
facts.note: The adjusted-EPS guidance column of the dossier's table is fully correct (raised/held at every checkpoint, as claimed). But the revenue-growth-guidance column is wrong on two points: (1) the initial FY2026 guide (Q4/FY2025 release, 2025-11-05) was total-company revenue growth of 5%-7%, not the 7%-9% the dossier states; (2) the Q1 FY26 release (2026-02-04) actually RAISED the revenue guide from 5-7% to 7-9% -- it was not 'reaffirmed, unchanged' as the dossier's table states (only the EPS guide was reaffirmed at Q1). The dossier's downstream narrative in §3 ('revenue-growth guidance was cut...from 7% to 9%...to 4% to 6%') is directionally salvageable using the Q1-to-Q3 comparison, but the table's own initial-guide value and Q1 characterization are factually incorrect. This does not affect kill criterion 1 (EPS-guidance-cut trigger), which remains correctly stated and unbroken.
